meta.title: Invoice Aging Report: refused for a user without the AP Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Manager role and verify Invoice Aging Report is refused or absent.
Sign in as an AP Manager on the same Growth tenant and verify Invoice Aging Report is available and can generate an aging report by bucket.
Compare the two role outcomes under identical tenant conditions.
